title: Microsoft 365 Copilot mobile app: capture voice notes
summary: Hold: the briefing treats retention coverage as unpublished even though Microsoft documents retention and eDiscovery for Copilot prompts and responses. Its indirect-cost-only rating also conflicts with the documented Copilot add-on requirement. The roadmap facts and licence-assignment controls are supported; recording-specific storage, default and administration details remain unconfirmed.

claims.where: Why it matters; Risk assessment: Data exposure; Open questions; rationale: risk
claims.claim: Microsoft has not stated whether retention controls reach the content produced by this Copilot feature.
claims.quote: A hidden folder in the user's mailbox stores user prompts and Copilot responses. You can search this content by using eDiscovery, monitor it by using Communication Compliance, and manage it by using retention policies.
claims.fix: Replace the broad retention-coverage gap with: 'Microsoft documents retention policies and eDiscovery for Copilot prompts and responses; handling of voice-note recordings and feature-specific saved artifacts is not yet documented.' Cite https://learn.microsoft.com/copilot/plan/architecture-data-protection-auditing. Narrow the corresponding Why it matters, risk rationale and Open questions wording to recordings and feature-specific artifacts.
